"""Compare the committed candidate and every stored review artifact with disk."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / 'artifacts/hs0002-20260910'
dest = root / 'docs/engineering/evidence/hs0002-20260910'
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
expected = json.loads((out / 'final-candidate-files.json').read_text())['files']
commands = []
for name, sha in expected.items():
    command = ['git', 'show', f'{head}:{name}']
    content = subprocess.check_output(command)
    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == sha
    assert content == (root / name).read_bytes()
    commands.append(command)
paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', head,
                                 '--', str(dest.relative_to(root))], text=True).splitlines()
assert paths
for name in paths:
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{head}:{name}']) == (root / name).read_bytes()
status = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True)
assert not status, 'Readback requires a clean committed worktree'
verdicts = {name: hashlib.sha256((dest / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for name in ['codeaudit-final-verdict.md', 'v1-final-verdict.md', 'v2-final-verdict.md']}
record = {'wu': 'HS-00.02', 'status': 'LOCAL_COMMITTED', 'green_commit': head,
          'red_commits': ['0263108eab043dbb4780f7c9ca6ac0528808b31d',
                          '8bef581b2ee64dd57345f92f11f241e0c927b759'],
          'verified_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'candidate_sha256': expected, 'verdict_sha256': verdicts,
          'committed_evidence_files_match': len(paths), 'worktree_clean_at_readback': True,
          'remote_ci': 'NOT_RUN', 'push_pr_merge': 'NOT_RUN', 'live_p17': 'NOT_RUN',
          'credential_incident': 'OPEN; validity and rotation not verified',
          'evidence_type': 'local same-UID readback, not independent receipt',
          'read_commands': commands}
(out / 'green-readback.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'green_commit': head, 'candidate_files_match': len(expected),
                  'evidence_files_match': len(paths), 'status': 'LOCAL_COMMITTED'}))
